operation.title: Guarded actions
operation.description: Check the exact target, live permission and impact before a change. Actions require a separate operator write profile.
operation.riskRestart: Restart can briefly interrupt this workload.
operation.riskScale: Changing capacity can interrupt service or increase resource use. Zero replicas stops all instances.
operation.acknowledge: I checked this target and accept this impact.
operation.failedRequest: This request was rejected or could not be checked. Refresh this resource and check permission before a new preview.
operation.unknown: The response was lost. The change may have happened. Check saved actions below before any new request.
operation.expired: This preview expired. Check the impact again.
operation.historyDescription: Saved outcomes recover a lost reply. Accepted means the provider accepted a change; it does not prove a healthy rollout.
operation.empty: No saved actions in this page.
operation.historyError: Saved actions are unavailable. Do not repeat a change whose outcome is unknown.
operation.cap: Showing at most 1,000 saved actions. Older actions remain stored.
